name: 85203 · Mesa, AZ
findings: ZIP 85203 (Mesa) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85203 (Mesa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85203 (Mesa) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
